_comment: Files allowed to use a Quickshell API, each with what it is the platform's home for. `scripts/check_structure.py` fails on a use not listed here or in `structure-baseline.json`'s `quickshell-use`, and on an entry no longer used.

screen-type.reason: a screen is a value every surface and host passes; it names no behaviour

rounded-clip.reason: CLAUDE.md › UI: ClippingRectangle for rounded clips; Qt has no antialiased rounded clip without a layer or shader

clock.reason: a relative time that stays current reads a SystemClock; it ticks aligned to the wall clock with no Timer in UI

diff-model.reason: keeps delegates alive across list updates by key; KeptList keeps array identity, not delegates

Quickshell.Bluetooth.reason: Bluetooth is the daemon's (backend/internal/bluez): use BluetoothManager

qml/components/bar/BarPanel.qml.reason: the bar's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/content/parts/TrayMenuLis.reason: anchors a popup to the window it sits in

qml/components/hosts/overlay/OverlayPane.reason: the overlay's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/overlay/ReservedAre.reason: the reserved area's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/popout/BarPopouts.q.reason: the bar popouts's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/popout/EdgePopout.q.reason: the edge popout's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/popout/EdgeTrigger..reason: the edge trigger's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/popout/PopoutAnchor.reason: anchors a popup to the window it sits in

qml/components/hosts/popout/SubPopout.qm.reason: the sub-popout's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/window/LayerOrigin..reason: the layer origin's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/hosts/window/PageWindow.q.reason: a page's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/reusable/StyledComboEntry.reason: anchors a popup to the window it sits in

qml/components/reusable/StyledToolTip.qm.reason: the tooltip's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/backdrop/ScreenB.reason: the screen backdrop's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/border/BorderPan.reason: the screen border's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/border/RoundedBo.reason: the rounded borders's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/desktop/DesktopW.reason: the desktop's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/dock/DockMenu.qm.reason: anchors a popup to the window it sits in

qml/components/surfaces/dock/DockWindow..reason: the dock's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterW.reason: the greeter's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/launcher/Launche.reason: the Scope root of a multi-window surface

qml/components/surfaces/lockscreen/LockP.reason: the lock screen preview's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/menu/FreeMenu.qm.reason: a free menu's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/menu/IntegratedE.reason: an integrated edge menu's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/menu/MenuHosts.q.reason: the Scope root of a multi-window surface

qml/components/surfaces/monitors/Monitor.reason: the monitor prompt's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/notifications/To.reason: the toasts's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerM.reason: the power menu's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/prompt/PromptWin.reason: the prompt's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/screenshare/Scre.reason: shows a live output or window

qml/components/surfaces/screenshot/Scree.reason: shows a live output or window

qml/components/surfaces/wallpaper/Wallpa.reason: the wallpaper's window: a window of its own kind

qml/components/surfaces/workspaces/Windo.reason: shows a live output or window

qml/components/views/Keybinds/KeyRecorde.reason: inhibits compositor shortcuts while recording, and anchors the inhibitor to the window it sits in

qml/config/Paths.qml.reason: the environment the daemon starts the shell with, and the runtime's shellDir

qml/services/compositor/FocusGrab.qml.reason: builds a protocol object only while active

qml/services/compositor/LayerManager.qml.reason: maps a LayerStack row to the Wayland layer, and the keyboard mode to WlrKeyboardFocus

qml/services/core/BackendManager.qml.reason: the daemon connection: its socket, and the runtime's processId, below Paths in the layering

qml/services/core/ConfigManager.qml.reason: its data dirs and snapshot, below Paths in the layering

qml/services/session/PolkitManager.qml.reason: builds a protocol object only while active, and survives a config reload

qml/services/ui/PageWindowManager.qml.reason: survives a config reload, and reads the runtime's appId

qml/shell/BlurBackingWindow.qml.reason: the chrome backing's window: a window of its own kind

qml/shell/Greeter.qml.reason: the windowed greeter: it must exist even with no monitor connected (a stand-in screen then)

qml/shell/GreeterPreview.qml.reason: the preview window has a screen to open on even with no monitor connected (a stand-in one then)

qml/shell/HotCorners.qml.reason: the hot corners's window: a window of its own kind

qml/shell/Lockscreen.qml.reason: the lock is a Wayland session lock; its preview window has a screen to open on even with no monitor connected (a stand-in one then)

qml/shell/NoParentNotice.qml.reason: runs without the daemon or config: its window, and the screens it reads with no General to ask

qml/shell/WorkspaceOverlay.qml.reason: the workspace overlay's window: a window of its own kind
